items.title: 3 S&P 500 Stocks with Warning Signs
items.summary: The S&P 500 (^GSPC) is often seen as a benchmark for strong businesses, but that doesn’t mean every stock is worth owning. Some companies face significant challenges, whether it’s stagnating growth, heavy debt, or disruptive new competitors.

items.title: After Plunging 9.9% in 4 Weeks, Here's Why the Trend Might Reverse for General Dynamics (GD)
items.summary: General Dynamics (GD) has become technically an oversold stock now, which implies exhaustion of the heavy selling pressure on it. This, combined with strong agreement among Wall Street analysts in revising earnings estimates higher, indicates a potential trend reversal for the stock in the near term.

items.title: LUNR Stock Rises 75.4% in the Past Year: What Should Investors Do?
items.summary: Intuitive Machines has surged 75.4% in a year as contract wins and a record backlog fuel growth, but losses and rich valuation cloud near-term upside.

items.title: How Far Could Boeing Stock Fall If The Market Turns?
items.summary: Boeing (BA) stock trades near $206, down 11.3% over the past month and 10.6% over the past year, while the S&P 500 returned 18.5% over the same twelve months. The question is how far a company still posting a twelve-month operating loss could fall, and for how long.

items.title: General Dynamics (GD) Falls More Steeply Than Broader Market: What Investors Need to Know

items.title: White House reviewed potential replacements for Pentagon deputy Feinberg - Reuters
items.summary: Investing.com -- The White House has reviewed candidates who could potentially replace U.S. Deputy Secretary of Defense Steve Feinberg, Reuters reported exclusively on Friday, citing three people familiar with the discussions.
